verdict.rationale: Cognee documents a session concept (user_id/session_id) that stores an ordered list of recent interactions, plus .remember/.recall/.improve operations explicitly designed to bridge short-term session memory into permanent memory so an agent can retrieve prior context via recall(). This maps well to 'resuming past sessions' but the docs describe retrieval/graph-building rather than an explicit 'session summary' output, and there is no independent/hands-on evidence confirming this works in practice for session continuity. missing for 10: explicit summarization feature (vs. raw recall), independent/hands-on validation of cross-session continuity.
